subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker until both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths are proven fixed, or should the ADC/gaxios path be split into a separate canonical issue now?
rationale: The issue combines two source-supported failure slices and active PRs cover only parts of them; deciding whether to keep one canonical tracker or split the dependency/auth-stack path is a maintainer-owned triage/product boundary choice.

options.title: Keep This Canonical
options.body: Review the sanitizer and onboarding PRs, but keep this issue open until live Vertex proof or a split follow-up covers the native ADC/gaxios null-object path.

options.title: Split ADC/Gaxios
options.body: Create a focused canonical follow-up for the gaxios/node-fetch/domexception ADC failure and close this issue only after the sanitizer slice lands and points to that follow-up.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Closure Later
options.body: A provider owner may override live proof for the sanitizer slice, but should preserve the ADC reproduction somewhere durable before closing.

recommendation.title: Keep This Canonical
recommendation.body: Review the sanitizer and onboarding PRs, but keep this issue open until live Vertex proof or a split follow-up covers the native ADC/gaxios null-object path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and live review context tie the choice to shared plugin-SDK Google thinking helpers plus provider/auth policy surfaces.
